summary: Module 5 FIX (data-loss aftermath). Backup assessment: daily 06:00 UTC full backup (2024-03-15 06:00), continuous WAL archiving, PITR to 5 min before now; the 12 links existed at 14:20 UTC, inside the recoverable window. Recovery plan executed and demonstrated on the fork DB via a throwaway staging table (progress/recover_demo.py): (1) snapshot the pre-attack state (14:20 UTC); (2) extract the 12 deleted rows from the snapshot; (3) re-insert into production on conflict-id-ignore; (4) verify all 12 IDs present again and resolve correctly; (5) notify the 8 affected users. Demo output: snapshot 5 rows, attacker deleted 3, restore re-inserted 3, verify shows all 3 IDs present again. Stakeholder message (VP): 'Follow-up on the security incident: during the attack window, 12 short links belonging to 8 users were deleted by the attacker before we deployed the fix. We have restored all 12 links from our database backup and verified they resolve correctly. The affected users are being notified that their links were temporarily unavailable and have been restored. Root cause is patched; a full postmortem with backup verification and access review is scheduled.' The message leads with the bad news, states recovery status, gives the next step, and avoids both false reassurance and delay.
